scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.deploy:check: npm --prefix backend run db:validate && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run qa:routes:smoke && npm --prefix backend run ops:preflight
scripts.docker:db:push: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.prod.yaml --profile tools run --rm backend-tools npm exec prisma db push -- --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.docker:db:foundation: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.prod.yaml --profile tools run --rm backend-tools npm run db:foundation
scripts.docker:seed-admin: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.prod.yaml exec backend npm run auth:seed-admin
